title: tephrocactus microdiscus
intro: Tephrocactus microdiscus, commonly known as the "Mexican ball cactus," is a species of cactus in the family Opuntiaceae. This plant is known for its small, rounded stems, often covered in fine, white spines, and is native to the Mexican deserts. Tephrocactus microdiscus has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic and anti-edematous effects.
